title: Reduce complexity
why: A function exceeds configured complexity thresholds.
suggestion: Split or simplify the function, or document a local suppression when one cohesive parser or traversal must retain shared state.
limitations: JavaScript and TypeScript extraction covers named declarations, methods, and block-bodied variable arrow functions.
Anonymous callbacks and expression-bodied arrow functions are not measured.
Cyclomatic complexity counts each logical operator, while cognitive complexity counts a consecutive chain of the same logical operator once.
